.²1 As a prefix to verbs it implies separation (away from, outside of),

.²2 As a prefix to nouns, not directly derived from verbs, it forms nouns
 or adjectives), and has the sense of
.³({%a%}) ‘out of’, ‘away from’; as in {#nirvana, nizkOSAmbi#}; or
.³({%b%}) more usually, ‘not’, ‘without’, ‘devoid of’ (having a privative
 force); {#niHSeza#} ‘without a remainder’; {#nizPala, nirjala#}, <ab>&c.</ab>
 {%<ab>N. B.</ab>%} In compound the {#s#} of {#nis#} is changed to {#r#} before vowels
